name: toolchain
description: Author grounded natural-language briefs and manage requirements agreement, dependencies, and delivery alongside safe repository work.

interface.shortDescription: Authored briefs, requirements agreement, and delivery gates
interface.longDescription: Toolchain authors natural-language briefs with consistent style and visible explanations, develops requirements through iterative elicitation, and keeps business initiatives, product capabilities, software systems, and implementation distinct. It supports internal revisions, dependency review, and evidenced stakeholder sign-off while preserving source ownership. Its engineering, delivery, resource, and repository constraints apply to separately authorized work.
defaultPrompt: Author or revise this requirements brief
Elicit and clarify the domain knowledge behind this brief
Analyze this evidence into requirements and separate action items
Develop the product or software requirements for this capability
Prepare stakeholder review and reconcile the affected sign-offs
Verify every changed path through its real target-surface entry point before shipping
Enforce the Sentry observability invariant for this production change
Identify only legitimate storage or process cleanup candidates
Isolate this repository work before making changes
